cells.raw_text: Before rest time: 24 minutes (all First Steps environments and Beat Saber) [rowspan=1,colspan=12]
Take the ping-pong ball and put it in front of your face and move it closer and farther
Move an object in front of your eyes and follow it; shoot targets that appear in the exergame
Main room and Shots in Space (First Steps) [rowspan=1,colspan=3]
Main room: 11 minutes; Shots in Space: 7 minutes^(b) [rowspan=1,colspan=3]
Main room: 10 slow repetitions, then 10 fast repetitions; Shots in Space: 1 repetition for each gun [rowspan=1,colspan=3]
Shoot targets that appear randomly inside the virtual environment
Cut blocks with a saber while your head is fixed; hit a ball in the main room and fixate your gaze on its movement while your head is fixed
Beat Saber and main room of First Steps [rowspan=1,colspan=3]
Beat Saber: 3 minutes; main room: 11 minutes [rowspan=1,colspan=3]
Beat Saber: 1 repetition; main room: 10 slow repetitions, then 10 fast repetitions [rowspan=1,colspan=3]
Take a block from the virtual desk, bring it to the floor, and then move it above your head, while staring at it
Shrink your shoulders while dancing with a robot
Bend forward and move a virtual block between your knees
After rest time: 21 minutes (Beat Saber and Sports Scramble) [rowspan=1,colspan=12]
Sit down and stand up, and vice versa, with your eyes open
Stand up and move to the right while standing
Stand up and move to the right or the left while taking a bowling ball
Throw or hit a ball in front of your face
Throw the ball to hit the bowling pins under knee level
Before rest time: 24 minutes (main room of First Steps) [rowspan=1,colspan=12]
Take a block from the virtual desk and when you stand up, throw it at a virtual sign situated inside the virtual environment [rowspan=1,colspan=2]
Move a virtual block at eye level; take a virtual block and throw it from one hand to the other [rowspan=1,colspan=2]
10 repetitions moving the object, then 10 repetitions throwing the object [rowspan=1,colspan=2]
Take a virtual block, turn 360°, and throw the block to a located target in the environment [rowspan=1,colspan=2]
10 repetitions to the right, then 10 repetitions to the left [rowspan=1,colspan=2]
In a standing position with a narrow base of support, hit a ball and follow its movements with your head [rowspan=1,colspan=2]
5 repetitions (eg, 1 repetition lasts until the ball stops) [rowspan=1,colspan=2]
Take the ping-pong ball and put it in front of your face, then move it closer and farther away [rowspan=1,colspan=2]
Take the ping-pong racket and hit blocks to one side and the other, following them with your head [rowspan=1,colspan=2]
Take a virtual block from the desk, then move it to the floor and bring it above your head while standing on a foam surface [rowspan=1,colspan=2]
After rest time: 21 minutes (Shots in Space in First Steps, Beat Saber, and Sports Scramble) [rowspan=1,colspan=12]
Shoot targets with a single gun while supported on a single leg, then the other [rowspan=1,colspan=2]
Shoot targets with a double gun while maintaining a tandem position [rowspan=1,colspan=2]
Shoot targets with a machine gun while standing on a foam surface [rowspan=1,colspan=2]
Hit and cut blocks in a specific direction with sabers while standing on a foam surface; the head is fixed while you make ocular movements [rowspan=1,colspan=2]
Throw the ball in a baseball stadium while standing on a foam surface [rowspan=1,colspan=2]
Bowl while standing on a foam surface [rowspan=1,colspan=2]
Walk down a bowling alley while moving your head from side to side and the throw the bowling ball [rowspan=1,colspan=2]

^(a)Within this set of exercises, all exercises in the main room of the First Steps environment combined were performed in 11 minutes. ^(b)Within this set of exercises, all Shots in Space exercises combined were performed in 7 minutes. ^(c)Within this set of exercises, all bowling exercises in Sports Scramble combined were performed in 6 minutes.
^(a)Within this set of exercises, all exercises in the main room of the First Steps environment combined were performed in 11 minutes.
^(b)Within this set of exercises, all Shots in Space exercises combined were performed in 7 minutes.
^(c)Within this set of exercises, all bowling exercises in Sports Scramble combined were performed in 6 minutes.

^(a)Dizziness Handicap Inventory scores range from 0 to 100 for the global scale; the physical subscale ranges from 0 to 28; the emotional and functional subscales range from 0 to 36. ^(b)Berg Balance Scale scores range from 0 to 56: 41-56 (low fall risk); 21-40 (medium fall risk); 0-20 (high fall risk). ^(c)Modified Fatigue Impact Scale scores range from 0 to 84; the physical effort subscale ranges from 0 to 36; the cognoscitive effort subscale ranges from 0 to 40; the psychosocial effort subscale ranges from 0 to 8. ^(d)The MyotonPRO takes three consecutive measurements and reports the final value as the mean; however, the SD is not reported. ^(e)N/A: not applicable; the System Usability Scale was only administered at T2. ^(f)A 90% value on the System Usability Scale represents a grade of A.
^(a)Dizziness Handicap Inventory scores range from 0 to 100 for the global scale;
the physical subscale ranges from 0 to 28;
the emotional and functional subscales range from 0 to 36.
^(b)Berg Balance Scale scores range from 0 to 56: 41-56 (low fall risk);
^(c)Modified Fatigue Impact Scale scores range from 0 to 84;
the physical effort subscale ranges from 0 to 36;
the cognoscitive effort subscale ranges from 0 to 40;
the psychosocial effort subscale ranges from 0 to 8.
^(d)The MyotonPRO takes three consecutive measurements and reports the final value as the mean;
however, the SD is not reported.
the System Usability Scale was only administered at T2.
^(f)A 90% value on the System Usability Scale represents a grade of A.

limitations: Series cover the Table 2 patient outcome rows only. Table 1 (protocol exercise rows) and the Table 2 group heading artefact rows are listed as cells but are not measurement series.
Table 2 grid columns are offset by one against the header (the row label occupies its own cell), so each value cell is paired with the header cell one column to its left by position.
Units printed only in a group heading (points, %, Hz) are not in any cell and are left null.
